item.title: Globe Business Launches Intelligent Transformation Framework at G Summit 2026
item.summary: Globe Business introduced its Intelligent Transformation framework at G Summit 2026, integrating connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, application programming interfaces (APIs), and artificial intelligence (AI) into a unified enterprise architecture. Globe Business said the framework intends to help enterprises integrate multiple digital platforms.
